pr_title: [wasm] Unmanaged structs are considered blittable if module has `DisableRuntimeMarshallingAttribute`
pr_body:
Consider all types in pinvokes from assembly marked with `DisableRuntimeMarshallingAttribute` as blittable.
Based on API proposal in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/60639.

- PInvokeTableGenerator: Avoid crash when processing unmanaged callbacks with function pointers.

Fixes #61146.

issue_context.title: (Unmanaged) Structs are not considered blittable by Emscripten / Blazor WASM AOT
issue_context.body:
### Description

Unmanaged structs are not considered blittable and therefore cannot be used in pinvoke callbacks.

### Reproduction Steps

Attempt to compile code like
```cs
public struct S { public int Value; }

[UnmanagedCallersOnly]
public void M(S myStruct) { }
```
using Emscripten / WASM AOT

### Expected behavior

The above code should compile.

### Actual behavior

An error is shown, structs are not considered blittable.

### Regression?

_No response_

### Known Workarounds

_No response_

### Configuration

Tested on .NET 6 RC2

### Other information

_No response_

Note that this is also related to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/60639 - in particular we will need to follow the runtime's (updated) per-assembly rules for what is blittable

Given the workaround requires changes to the native side, which isn't always possible (ie binding to standardized or otherwise externally defined APIs), I would not consider this as an enhancement, but rather a missing feature that is important to making interop in WASM fully functional.
